title: Booty Royale: Never Go Down Without a Fight! Manga Gets TV Anime in January
content: WWWave Corporation announced on Friday that its Deregula anime label is producing an anime adaptation of Rui Takatō 's Booty Royale: Never Go Down Without a Fight! ( Hagure Idol Jigokuhen ) manga that will premiere in January 2027.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Hagure Idol: Jigoku-hen' Gets TV Anime in Winter 2027
content: WWWave Corporation 's Deregula animation label opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Rui Takatou 's Hagure Idol: Jigoku-hen ( Booty Royale: Never Go Down Without a Fight! ) manga on Friday, revealing the main cast, staff, and a commemorative visual (pictured).
author: MyAnimeList

title: Amahara's 33 Years Old Single Girl Knight Captain Manga Gets Anime
content: Digital Shokunin annoucned on Friday that it is producing an anime adaptation of manga creator Amahara 's 33-sai Dokushin Onna Kishi Taichō (33 Years Old Single Girl Knight Captain [sic] ) manga.
author: ANN

title: Despite Fan Backlash, Dragon Ball Super Remake Is One of the Biggest Hits of Fall 2026
content: Netflix’s weekly ranking chart reveals that Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is one of the biggest hits of the year. The highly anticipated remake became a massive disappointment after the release of Episode 3, which was even before the main battle between Goku and Beerus.
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Miss Avatar: Seven Havens
content: The Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise keeps expanding as the latest animated series was released after 12 years to explore the exceptional worldbuilding and the captivating characters.
author: ComicBook

title: Ninja Skooler Anime Unveils Pilot Film, Images, Song
content: Makoto Kimura 's BLUE RIGHTS anime planning company unveiled on Friday a pilot film and images for Kinema Citrus ' original anime project Ninja Skooler . The company also digitally released the featured song "Knots" written and performed by Takashi Iwami .
author: ANN

title: Mashle: Magic and Muscles Manga Gets Live-Action Film on March 19
content: An early teaser visual announced on Wednesday that a live-action film of Hajime Kōmoto 's Mashle: Magic and Muscles manga will open on March 19, 2027. Warner Brothers and Fuji TV are overseeing the project, and CREDEUS is producing. TOHO will distribute the film.
author: ANN

title: 3 Fall 2026 Anime That Take Fans Back to the 2000s
content: Three anime in Fall 2026 perfectly capture the nostalgia of 2000s anime while delivering that classic shonen feel. The anime industry began to flourish with the emergence of classic shonen anime, many of which were released throughout the 2000s.
author: ComicBook

title: PlayStation 5 Reaches Over 97 Million Shipments
content: PS5 reached over 90 million shipments last February, and reached over 80 million shipments in August 2025. It surpassed 50 million in sales in December 2023. As of July 2021, Sony had sold over 10 million units of the PS5 worldwide since its launch, making the PS5 Sony 's fastest-selling console.
author: ANN

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Clearly Sets Up a Third Movie, Despite New Sequel Claiming “Everything Ends Here”
content: The ending of Godzilla Minus One in 2023 heralded the arrival of a sequel in a way that created more excitement than any other tease in the franchise’s history. Following his defeat, the heart of Godzilla began to sink to the ocean floor just as it started to regenerate and begin to beat again, signaling his return.
author: ComicBook
